text:
maria: Heads-up — CI found broken includes on the runtime guide after the last docs deploy. Some pages are erroring on render. Anyone owning runtime guide? cc @aj

docs-bot: build fail: docs-renderer v2.3.1 — error: "Include file not found: ../includes/fastpath.md" at /docs/runtime/serve.md:42

aj: I own the runtime guide, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the failing include paths or grep output?

maria: Output snippet below: `grep -R "Include file not found" -n ./public || true` returns:
- docs/runtime/serve.md:42:Include file not found: ../includes/fastpath.md
- docs/ops/batching.md:18:Include file not found: ../includes/batching-note.md

sam: Likely from the recent restructure where includes moved under docs/includes. Quick options: 1) restore symlinks, 2) change include paths to canonical absolute paths. I can do a small PR to fix the handful if you want. :wrench:

linda: Heads-up from i18n side — these includes are referenced in ja/ and es/ copies too. If we mass-edit paths we'll need a plan for localized files. Can we avoid touching localized dirs for now?

aj: Root cause: I moved the includes to docs/includes in the cleanup last week and missed updating a couple of files. Plan: restore temporary symlinks so builds pass, then run a path-normalization migration separately.

maria: Good plan. Can someone pick the temporary symlink PR and tag docs reviewers? Low-risk, quick. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll open the PR in ~30m to add symlinks + a tiny CI check to catch missing includes. I'll tag @docs-team and add label `needs-localization` so i18n can opt-in on the subsequent migration.

linda: Thanks — will watch for that label and coordinate with translators. If it's only symlink restores, localization shouldn't need to act yet.

aj: PR posted: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4123 — includes symlink restore + one-line CI tweak. Please review when you can.

maria: Verified staging render looks good after the PR merged. Thanks everyone. Leaving follow-up: create DOCS ticket to normalize include paths across the repo and document recommended include conventions for localized folders.

docs-bot: ticket created: DOCS-789 - Normalize include paths across repo and add migration guide

maria: Closing thread here — ping if anything regresses. :)
